name: annas-mcp
description: Search books with Anna's Archive and papers and dissertations with OpenAlex, then download or read the selected work.

settings.name: Anna's Archive secret key (optional)
settings.description: Anna's Archive key for archive operations. Leave empty when using only OpenAlex.

settings.name: OpenAlex API key (optional)
settings.description: OpenAlex key for paper and dissertation search, open PDFs and structured text. Hosted files consume the account allowance.

settings.name: Download folder (optional)
settings.description: Where downloaded files are saved. Leave empty for annas-archive in your home folder.

settings.name: Account cookie (optional)
settings.description: Leave empty. Only needed if signing in with the secret key fails: the aa_account_id2 cookie from a signed-in browser.
